Personally, I have a rooted Nexus 5 running Cataclysm.

  • AdAway blocks in app ad banners and some browser ads

  • Titanium backup for apps & data backup

  • Some cosmetic changes to UI

Ad block and Titanium back up is the biggest thing for me. I think today's phones are good enough that you don't have to have a custom ROM for batter life and quick response. If you have the time, it's a fun thing to tinker with and see some neat things added to Android. Some custom ROM features eventually end up in stock Android. You can always restore the phone to original factory state, as long as you know what you're doing.
